original_source: Fresh IID even-native qutrits, actual paired covariant readout, two full uniform modular labels and uniform ALL secrets.
implemented_baseline: Exact sparse cyclotomic meet-in-the-middle computation of three posterior Fourier coefficients, with rigorous ball positivity/ordering and full exponential state/join accounting.
new_representations: Weighted signed-root difference partition function with correlated paired noise
Canonical sparse Z[X]/Phi_(3^r) phase coefficients; exact cancellation, not numerical zero tests
Least-trit class posterior from C_0 and C_(+/-q/3 e_j)

Original-basis final-POVM Hamming radius, explicitly distinct from gate locality or entanglement

proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-REVIEW: Independent review of posterior duality, paired likelihood Gram, class-mixture bounds and sparse relation union gate.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-COST: Polynomial full-source runtime and memory, not merely half enumeration; count dense phase joins and cancellation costs.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-WEAK-GUARANTEE: Prove inverse-polynomial average-all-secret least-trit advantage across required lower roots; single posterior/MAP controls are insufficient.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SOURCE: Retain full modulus, correlated pairs, fresh original IDs and IID label acquisition; no chosen labels or field-shadow replacement.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-ESTIMATOR: Supply a computable receiver outcome estimator, not a free nuisance-fiber inverse or a formal relation count.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SCOPE: Do not promote output-record-degree or final-effect-radius gates to generic learning/circuit hardness.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Prove natural-problem acquisition and original quantum costs separately.

falsifiers: The exact posterior disagrees with original Born likelihoods or bounded all-secret reference.
Independent marginal errors replace correlated paired noise.
Formal target relations are scored as advantage despite the q9 exact phase-cancellation control.
Budget/precision exhaustion or zero likelihood produces a partial certified trit.
